title: Mochizuki Honami — Discovering The Joys Of Drumming〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Honami's Room

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So much happened today...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not only was the offer we received regarding FizzYum Cider a wonderful surprise, we got to have a fun party in SEKAI too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And the stories about our childhood were so nostalgic.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Listening to Ichika reminded me of when I first learned to play the drums...

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, Mochizuki, are you ready to start learning how to play the drums?

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I'm ready!

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line:
Ah, excellent.
Then, let's begin by teaching your hands how to create a steady rhythm.

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line:
I'll start the metronome...
You tap the snare, okay? That's the leftmost drum.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: O-Okay! I'll try...!

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: (So... I'm supposed to tap the drum whenever it clicks, right?)

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: I didn't know it made this kind of sound!

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: Hehe. It's nice, right?

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: There's a way to make it produce an even more fun sound. I'll show you that a little later.

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: But before I do, you should first learn what playing the drums entails.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: What it entails...?

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: Yes. I'm sure you've seen other people play the drums before, but you play using both hands and both feet.

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: Try tapping the cymbals to your left like you did with the snare drum just now.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I thought it would be much louder...
It produces more of a clink instead of a clang.

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: So, you can produce different kinds of sounds with those cymbals.

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line:
See the pedal at the bottom?
Try tapping them again after depressing that.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: Umm... The pedal...? Oh, this one?

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: Huh? It sounds completely different...!

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: See what I mean? So, let's try putting what you just learned into practice.

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: Next, I want you to tap like normal and then depress the pedal.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: Yes, that's it! Now repeat what you just did.

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: Good! Alright, now, I'll play something while using every piece of this kit.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: (This seems really cool all of a sudden...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: (And you can produce all these different sounds at the same time...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: (Incredible...! This is what you can do on the drums...!)

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, why don't we stop here for today.

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: Keep practicing what I taught you to do on the snare drum today. It's okay to go at your own pace.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: I will!

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you very much for doing this.
I had a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: I was actually worried whether I'd be able to teach you properly because it'd been a while since I last played the drums.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: Oh, did you use to be in a band...?

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: Yes, I was in the Light Music Club during high school.

rows.Speaker: Music Teacher
rows.Line: I don't know how good a teacher I'm going to be, but I promise to do my best to keep nurturing your interest in playing the drums.

rows.Speaker: Little Honami
rows.Line: Thank you! I also promise to do my best!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right off the bat, that teacher showed me just how much fun it is to play the drums...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I was so worried at first, but that quickly turned into wanting to practice and get better.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Such a wonderful teacher.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I wonder if you still remember me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, you don't have to remember me. I just hope that you get a chance to hear our song someday.
